metadata.title: Supervised Machine Learning-Based Multiclass Classification and Interpretable Feature Importance Analysis of Teacher Job Satisfaction

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are derived satisfaction indices rather than using PV-based achievement outcomes.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply weights in the analysis of the teacher data.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses individual teacher-level models without accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation using train/test splits and did not validate findings on external datasets.
